device.description: Device slice. Omit for all devices.

range.description: Date-range preset. Mutually exclusive with from/to; pass either range or both from and to.

tags.description: Page tag names from list_tags. Keeps only pages carrying any of these tags.

urlContains.description: Case-insensitive text matched anywhere in the page URL, or a list of up to 1000 such texts. Adds summary totals for all matching pages; with a list, also url_contains_totals per text (batch call: no page list, no cursor).

name: get_top_pages

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor to fetch the next page; null on the last page.

render_with.description: Render tool that can display this payload.

summary.description: Only with url_contains: current-period totals over every page matching the filter, not just this page of results. With a list of texts: the overall total over every page matching at least one text (each page counted once), with ctr and position.

url_contains_totals.description: Only with url_contains as a list: current-period totals per text, in the order of the input list (one entry per input text, duplicates included). ctr is a clicks/impressions ratio and position is impression-weighted; both are null when there is nothing to compute them from.

title: Top pages
